reviews.title: Excellent 4K Monitor with Clean USB-C Setup
reviews.comment: Sharp 4K image quality, excellent color and text clarity, and the USB-C connectivity makes for a very clean single-cable workstation setup. The monitor feels premium, performs reliably, and has been outstanding for productivity, multitasking, and everyday use. Great balance of quality, features, and value for my use case.
